name: Gifthunter2.io
author: Addicting Games
description: Gifthunter2.io is a free iogame. Ho ho ho and welcome to Giftmas, the yearly festival where gifts become sentient for one night a year and fight other sentient gifts for survival and possibly escape. In this game, you'll be armed with the same auto-repeater item as all of your gift friends. It is your responsibility to take cover as you hunt down other gifts and try to be the last gift standing. In this game, you'll be aided by the fact that the entire arena is filled with other boxes that look exactly like you. Al you have to do in order to blend in is just stop moving, Beware opposing players who might have noticed you running and then stopping. It is easy to get caught but its also easy to not get caught, it all depends on your vibe. Opposing players in this game are extremely sensitive to vibes. So, good luck with your giftmas battle royale. Maybe if you're lucky you will be able to take down the opposing boxes before they take you down.
